triplets.head: FCC (United States)

triplets.head: FCC (United States)

triplets.tail: Evaluates and recognizes accreditation bodies that accredit TCBs and test labs

triplets.head: A2LA

triplets.head: ANAB

triplets.head: ILAC MRA
triplets.tail: Lab competence recognition — National Accreditation Bodies peer-evaluate each other under ISO/IEC 17011

triplets.head: ILAC MRA
triplets.tail: Recognizes lab competence only; regulators may still require local testing or national standards

triplets.head: ILAC MRA
triplets.tail: A2LA and ANAB (USA), CNAS (China), KOLAS (South Korea), DAkkS (Germany), JAB and IA Japan (Japan), NATA (Australia), UKAS (UK), and 100+ others

triplets.head: IECEE CB Scheme
triplets.tail: Product safety test results accepted across 54+ countries

triplets.head: IECEE CB Scheme
triplets.tail: One test, one certificate accepted in 54+ countries

triplets.head: IECEE CB Scheme
triplets.tail: Manufacturer applies to any NCB (National Certification Body) for a CB Test Certificate

triplets.head: IECEE CB Scheme
triplets.tail: Associated CBTL (CB Testing Laboratory) tests product to IEC standards (e.g., IEC 62368-1)

triplets.head: IECEE CB Scheme
triplets.tail: NCB issues CB Test Certificate (CBTC) and CB Test Report (CBTR)

triplets.head: IECEE CB Scheme
triplets.tail: Other participating NCBs review CBTC/CBTR and issue local certification with minimal or no additional testing

triplets.head: IECEE CB Scheme
triplets.tail: A charger tested to IEC 62368-1 at a CBTL can use that CB report to obtain PSE (Japan), KC safety (Korea), and CE (EU) without full re-testing

triplets.head: FCC
triplets.tail: APEC TEL MRA (Phase II) — covers Canada, Singapore, Hong Kong, South Korea, Australia, and others

triplets.head: US–EU MRA
triplets.tail: A US TCB can act as an EU Notified Body and directly issue CE/RED certifications

triplets.head: US–Japan MRA
triplets.tail: A US TCB can act as a Japan RCB and issue Giteki (Radio Law) certifications

triplets.head: Government MRAs
triplets.tail: South Korea typically requires in-country testing at Korean labs even under APEC TEL MRA

triplets.head: Government MRAs

triplets.head: Government MRAs
